values: Record results after running each case.
Remaining = Not Run + Blocked. Pass / plan uses all planned cases.
Scope: Sprint 1 plan and actual task lists. Later AI generation, quality scoring, chatbot evaluation and collaboration enhancements are excluded.
Landscape is inferred to mean the public landing page at /. Homepage is mapped to the authenticated project overview at /projects. The source has no route or component named Landscape.
Revision date is 03 Nov 2026. Sprint dates below are planned dates from the sprint workbook, not test execution dates. Actual results, reviewer and evaluation date are intentionally blank.
Use an isolated test database and disposable repositories. A and B are separate ordinary users with no shared project access. All passwords and tokens below are synthetic test fixtures.
Sprint source: C1SE.30_Sprint_COVAI_ver_1.0.xlsx, 'Sprint 1' sheet, planned B18:E53 and actual B60:E95. Task numbers and assigned members in the traceability table come from the plan.

API setup: use the configured test API origin (default http://localhost:5000), Content-Type: application/json for JSON bodies and Authorization: Bearer <A_TOKEN> for protected A requests. Replace P/S/JOB_ID and angle-bracket placeholders with fixture project, snapshot, job and token values.

Verdicts: keep Not Run until attempted. Use Blocked when a required fixture or planned UI is unavailable. Record observed results and evidence in Actual results before selecting Pass or Fail. Module owners are QA assignments from the sprint, not execution signatures.
